dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Can categorize objects by color or shape
activities: Play board games that involve strategy

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Has a vocabulary of about 1,500 words
Can retell a story in sequence
watchFor: Limited sleep and expressiveness in speech

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Can cut with scissors and draw simple shapes
activities: Provide outdoor play opportunities like climbing
Encourage arts and crafts that involve cutting and gluing
Participate in dance or movement activities
watchFor: Difficulty with tasks requiring hand coordination

dimensions.title: Social
activities: Encourage group activities like team sports
watchFor: Excessive shyness or aggression in social situations
Reluctance to engage in group settings

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Can identify and express basic emotions
activities: Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing
watchFor: Inability to cope with simple disappointments
Shows signs of anxiety in new situations

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Asks many questions about their environment
Shows interest in exploring new topics
activities: Encourage visits to museums or nature centers
Foster a garden to explore plant growth

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on tasks for about 15-20 minutes
Begins to understand cause and effect
activities: Introduce simple chores that have clear steps
Use educational apps or videos to support learning
watchFor: Frequent distractions when trying to focus
Struggles to complete tasks that involve multiple steps

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can make choices about play activities
activities: Offer choices in daily decisions like snacks
watchFor: Dependence on adults for tasks they should manage
Lack of initiative in choosing activities
